WITH grouped_income AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_member,
    SUM(amount) as group_sum
  FROM income
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(group_sum) as total_amount FROM grouped_income
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    gi.group_sum,
    gi.group_sum / ts.total_amount as share
  FROM grouped_income gi
  CROSS JOIN total_sum ts
),
average_share_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.group_sum,
    ws.share,
    asv.avg_share
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN average_share_val asv
  WHERE ws.share > asv.avg_share
)
SELECT
  SUM(group_sum) as total_summed_amount,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_share_difference
FROM filtered_groups;
